# Event Studio
> Premium event management platform for planning, organizing, and executing unforgettable corporate and social events worldwide.

## About
Event Studio is an award-winning event management company founded in 2009 by Alexandra Chen, a veteran of the luxury hospitality industry. Headquartered in New York City with offices in London and Singapore, the studio has grown from a boutique planning firm into a globally recognized event production powerhouse, celebrated for its creative vision and operational excellence across 1,200+ events in 50+ cities.

## Pages
- /: Home - Main landing page showcasing Event Studio's event management services, features, testimonials, and FAQ
- /services: Services - Comprehensive event management services including corporate conferences, weddings, product launches, virtual events, private parties, and team retreats
- /about: About - Company story, mission, values, leadership team, and statistics
- /contact: Contact - Global office locations, contact details, business hours, and emergency support
